To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

the adaptive Neyman procedure is powerful in detecting large nonparametric effects in the parametric regression models and that the power of the adaptive Neyman tests can be far greater than the power of the F test in many situations.

the proposed testing procedures have the following properties: (1) they are consistent against large classes of nonparametric alternatives, (2) their powers are comparable to the F test statistic in situations where the F-test statistic is known to be powerful and are much higher than the F-test in other situations, and (3) the proposed tests are omnibus in that they are applicable to any parametric models.

(a) the new testing procedures formalize and extend the existing model diagnostic tools, (b) the new tests are powerful and omnibus and can detect alternatives that cannot be detected by the F test, and (c) the new tests can be used to examine the adequacy of parametric models in many applications, including the partially linear models.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the development of new goodness-of-fit procedures that can be used to examine the adequacy of parametric regression models against nonparametric alternatives.
the problem of checking whether a parametric regression model is adequate for the data or not.
the development of new goodness-of-fit tests for parametric regression models.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the proposed procedures are indeed powerful, omnibus, and easy to implement.
the new testing procedure is a powerful tool to examine the adequacy of parametric models.
the adaptive Neyman tests are very powerful and can be recommended as a general tool for model diagnostics.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the new testing methods provide a powerful and flexible alternative for model checking.
the adaptive Neyman testing procedure is an effective tool for checking the adequacy of parametric regression models.
the adaptive Neyman tests are a useful tool for model checking and model selection.
The main takeaway from our work is that
a parametric regression model is a special case of a nonparametric regression model, and thus it should be checked against nonparametric models.
the adaptive Neyman tests can be applied to a wide range of parametric models and are more powerful than the classical F-test statistic.
the adaptive Neyman testing procedure can be used as an omnibus test for a broad class of parametric models.
